name: Slack Webform Handler
description: sends a Slack message when a webform is submitted.
project_description:
The Slack Webform Handler is a powerful contribution module designed to enhance the functionality of the popular Drupal Webform module by seamlessly integrating it with Slack, a leading team collaboration tool. With this module, Drupal site administrators can easily configure webforms to send submissions directly to Slack channels, enabling efficient communication and streamlined workflows.

 
Create Slack webhooks: 
 
 Navigate to your Slack workspace and sign in as an administrator or user with sufficient privileges. 
 Click on the "Browse Apps" 
 Select you app or create a new one 
 Select the "Incoming Webhooks" app from the sidebar. 
 Under " Webhook URLs for Your Workspace " click on Create new webhook for your workspace , Choose the Slack channel where you want the webform submissions to appear. Note that you may need to create a new channel if one doesn't already exist. 
 Once the channel is selected, click on "Allow" to grant the necessary permissions to the app. 
 You will be provided with a unique Webhook URL. Copy this URL as you will need it for configuring the Slack Webform Handler module in Drupal.
